message: 6 string literals reach the DOM from an expression: libs/components/widget/src/widget.ts: host `[textContent]` → "Delete the row" libs/components/widget/src/widget.ts: host `[innerText]` → "Delete the row" libs/components/widget/src/widget.ts: host `[outerText]` → "Delete the row" libs/components/widget/src/widget.ts: host `[innerHTML]` → "Delete the row" libs/components/widget/src/widget.ts: host `[innerHtml]` → "Remove the row" libs/components/widget/src/widget.ts: host `[outerHTML]` → "Delete the row"
description: Sentences a `host` block binds to the properties that draw their value as any element's content (`DRAWN_PROPERTIES`): `textContent`, `innerText`, `outerText`, `innerHTML` and `outerHTML`, and `innerHtml`, which the compiler sets as `innerHTML` (measured: Angular 22.2.1 sets each on the host, JIT and a render in jsdom with the setter recorded where jsdom implements none). The block's bindings were read by an attribute's name alone, and none of these is one; so all six passed.
